'''Zack Rhodebeck''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[June 2001 Mansfield tournament]] on 16 June 2001, according to David Monteiro's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2474">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-17-mansfield-ohio-6-16-01-numptiesd2474/ mansfield-ohio-6-16-01-numpties], DeckTech (David "JWRP119" Monteiro, 17 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-17-mansfield-ohio-6-16-01-numptiesd2474/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
